hero.title: Safety training your whole team can attend, and you can track
hero.lead: Buy seats for the courses you need, invite your employees, and follow enrolment, attendance and exam outcomes from one dashboard.

steps.title: Create your company account
steps.body: One manager account for your organisation. Commercial registration and VAT details are optional and can be added later.

steps.title: Buy seats
steps.body: Purchase seats per course in Saudi riyals. Seats can be used on any scheduled session of that course.

steps.title: Invite and assign employees
steps.body: Invite employees by email, then assign each person to the session and language that suits them.

steps.title: Follow progress
steps.body: See who is enrolled, whose attendance was recorded, who passed the exam, and download their certificates.

items.title: Seats
items.body: Purchased, assigned and remaining seats for every course, always up to date.

items.title: Employees and invitations
items.body: A simple employee list with invitation status. Employees create their own accounts.

items.title: Progress
items.body: Enrolment, attendance and exam outcome for each employee, without exposing their exam answers.

items.title: Certificates and reports
items.body: Open employee certificates and download a progress report as a spreadsheet file.

privacy.title: Your company's data stays yours
privacy.body: Each company sees only its own employees and records. Managers see what they need to manage training: names, work emails, progress and certificates.

inquiry.title: Larger teams or custom requirements
inquiry.lead: Need private sessions, a specific schedule, or training for a large group? Tell us what you need and we will reply by email.
inquiry.name: Your name
inquiry.messageHint: For example: courses, preferred dates, teaching language, number of people.
